set: Mūza brand direction (M/darbnīca) - classical and Rīga Art Nouveau image set

treatments.natural: '_cut.png' (cutouts) or '_natural.jpg' (crops): warm photographic grade; blacks lifted to ink #151413, whites rolled to warm off-white
treatments.green: '_green': duotone deep green #1F3A2D (shadows) to cream #EFE7D8 (highlights), interpolated in OKLab
treatments.rose: '_rose': duotone ink #151413 (shadows) to dusty rose #D9A6A1 (highlights), interpolated in OKLab

formats: Cutouts: 8-bit indexed PNG with full alpha (223 colours, plus 32 semi-transparent edge entries in 8 alpha steps, and 1 transparent). Crops: progressive JPG at quality 85, max 1400 px.
avoided_object_ids: All Met objectIDs in haralds-brand credits.json were excluded (none used).

entries.title: Marble head of a woman
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Marble head of a woman, 1st–2nd century CE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Fletcher Fund, 1930 (CC0).
entries.processing: Additional view 2 (strict profile). Background removed (watershed+GrabCut, guided-filter edge); mount rod removed; resized to ~1400 px.
entries.suggested_use: Hero cutout: pure right-facing profile; place type in the space in front of the face; works huge and cropped off an edge.

entries.title: Bronze statuette of a veiled and masked dancer
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Bronze statuette of a veiled and masked dancer, 3rd–2nd century BCE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Bequest of Walter C. Baker, 1971 (CC0).
entries.processing: Primary view. Background removed; foot and hem kept; floor shadow removed.
entries.suggested_use: Signature figure for music/dance nights: tall, veiled, in motion. Use full-height on posters or as a narrow column beside text.

entries.title: Mask, tragic female
entries.date: undated (Met lists no date; catalogue range 670 BCE–330 CE)
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Mask, tragic female. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Rogers Fund, 1906 (CC0).
entries.processing: Primary view. Background removed; through-holes (eyes, mouth, suspension hole) made transparent; red museum inventory number retouched out.
entries.suggested_use: Theatre/cinema motif; frontal and graphic. Eye and mouth openings are transparent, so a colour or photo can show through.

entries.title: Marble pilaster capital
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Marble pilaster capital, 1st half of 1st century CE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Fletcher Fund, 1926 (CC0).
entries.processing: Primary view. Background and cast shadow removed.
entries.suggested_use: Architectural accent: a crown above a headline or a footer anchor; volutes, acanthus and a small central head.

entries.title: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale, ca. 50–40 BCE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Rogers Fund, 1903 (CC0).
entries.processing: Detail view (additionalImages[1]) of the Boscoreale Room H panel; slight trims at the sides.
entries.suggested_use: Narrative image: seated woman with a kithara and a girl behind her chair; Pompeian red; works as a large editorial picture.

entries.title: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale
entries.institution: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
entries.attribution: Wall painting from Room H of the Villa of P. Fannius Synistor at Boscoreale, ca. 50–40 BCE. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Rogers Fund, 1903 (CC0).
entries.processing: Crop of the plain red wall in the upper right of the same panel (above the figures, below the painted cornice).
entries.suggested_use: Colour field: cracked Pompeian red plaster with no figures; use as a band, backdrop or texture behind type.
